title: Wonderful perfect little kitchen scale.
text: Wonderful perfect little kitchen scale.. This is very well packed to avoid damage. The scale has a very nice slim design. The screen is very bright and easy to read. I like the different measure options you can get, oz. lbs, ml. fl.oz and kg. Easy to turn on and off. I keep mine in the box and in a drawer. It doesnt take up any space at all. It tells you when the battery gets low,which is a great feature!  Comes with nice detailed instructions on how to use it and extra hints.

product_metadata.title: BRONA Digital Kitchen Food Scale 5KG / 11lb Multifunction for Cooking, Baking, Meal Prep, Keto Diet Weight Loss, 0.1oz / 1g Accuracy, Stainless Steel
features: The scale features a small, sleek and low-profile modern design, which can be perfectly convenient for daily baking, meal prep and keto diet.
One-button easy cycles through grams, ounces and volume mode (for weighing water or milk).
Tare / Zero function allows you to subtract the weight of a container, or weigh multiple ingredients continuously.
Fast reading with 1g/0.1 oz increments for remarkable precision, minimum weight recommendation 10 grams +.
Backlit LCD provides a bright and clear display in dim light; 30s backlit auto-off and 120s auto-off provide longer battery life.

details.Special Feature: Low Battery Indication, Fingerprint-proof, Back-lit Display, Overload Indication, Automatic Shut-Off
